d: Inspiring individuality with innovative craft since 1966, creativity lies at the heart of Bottega Veneta. Born in Vicenza, the house is rooted in Italian culture yet maintains a global outlook. An inclusive brand with exclusive products, Bottega Veneta is as much a feeling as it is an aesthetic.
Job Family Group Description - Sales / Omni-Channel
Combines all positions within the different sales channels: retail, wholesale and e-commerce. Also includes all activities to support store management.
Represents the brand to clients. Guides them at every stage of the buying journey. Provides support on styles, product characteristics and trends.

Advises our customers during the buying journey. Presents the collection using brand standards. As the visible face of the brand follows company values. Contributes to reaching set sales targets and enhances customer satisfaction.

To lead and manage the Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) functions, ensuring compliance with corporate quality standards, project specifications, and industry regulations. The QA/QC Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems across production and project activities.
q: Degree in Engineering or related discipline.
Minimum 8–10 years of experience in QA/QC within manufacturing or fit-out projects.
Strong knowledge of ISO9001, FSC, and industry standards.
Proficiency in digital quality systems and reporting tools.
Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
r: li
Establish and maintain corporate QA procedures and QC processes in line with ISO9001 and FSC standards.
li
Prepare and written procedures for production QC and corporate QA.
li
Implement digital systems for quality tracking and reporting (e.g., dashboards, barcode systems).
li
Oversee incoming material inspections, in-process checks, and final product audits across departments (Joinery, Metal, Polishing, Packaging).
li
Ensure only approved materials are used, and all work complies with approved drawings and method statements.
li
Control non-conforming products and initiate corrective actions in coordination with relevant managers.
li
Maintain quality records, Inspection Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, and method statements according to the Project Quality Management Plan (PQMP).
li
Establish and maintain a QC Inspection Report, with qualitative analysis and recommendations.
li
Establish and lead monthly operation meetings with key stakeholders where trends and improvement recommendations and initiatives are discussed, agreed and launched.
li
Prepare audit reports and monitor effectiveness of quality procedures.
li
Lead the QA/QC team and coordinate with project managers, site engineers, and subcontractors.
li
Implement training and development programs for staff to enhance quality awareness and prepare future leaders.
li
Analyze customer feedback and implement measures to mitigate recurring issues.
li
Drive business improvement initiatives and maintain a library of SOPs for quality processes.
